methodology_summary: See docs/recon/cli-census.md for full methodology. Section A = packages/tnf-cli command tree (130 top-level groups / 396 leaf commands / 488 total nodes, from the git-verified-fresh command-surface.snapshot.json oracle). Section B = root package.json scripts (427), grouped by namespace prefix into ~60 rows. Section C = the 20 authoritative scheduled system-framework processes in data/protocols/system-processes.json. Section D = 17 standalone cron/launchd service-control scripts reachable by NEITHER a tnf-cli command NOR a root package.json script. Section E = aggregate stats for the 1339 non-root workspace package.json scripts (not enumerated individually).
